evidence.title: Scape home
evidence.locator: Download, Your tools in your project, pricing/trial and FAQ
evidence.finding: The site documents a Mac download, parallel local sessions, Git worktrees, external integration records and a14-day trial that locks after expiry without a paid plan.

evidence.title: Scape harnesses
evidence.locator: Harness/CLI table; Capability differences; Installing sections; account profiles
evidence.finding: The agent guide names nine coding CLI harnesses, exact commands and per-harness authentication/capability limits. Only Claude Code is listed for remote SSH sessions.

evidence.title: Scape argus-doc
evidence.locator: Creating an Argus; How it works; Modes; Scheduled Events
evidence.finding: Argus is a long-lived product manager session that reads a mission, starts real child sessions in worktrees and monitors/messages them. It has Watching/Sleeping/Disabled modes and future scheduled events.

evidence.title: Scape triggers
evidence.locator: Opening warning; When table; Creating a trigger and arming
evidence.finding: Product triggers react to webhooks, integration records, table queries and calendar events, after human arming. Evaluation requires Scape open; webhook arming requires Supporter.

evidence.title: Scape ssh
evidence.locator: Using SSH connections; Remote worktrees; Session status on remote hosts
evidence.finding: Saved SSH profiles support remote terminals/SFTP and Claude coding sessions, with remote worktree creation scoped to a live matching connection.

evidence.title: Scape cli
evidence.locator: Beta notice; Start an agent; URL restrictions
evidence.finding: The beta scape CLI opens/focuses projects and can start installed agents with a prompt/model; URL schemes cannot start an agent.

evidence.title: Scape code-editor
evidence.locator: Diff view: original HEAD content versus current content, next/previous hunk controls
evidence.finding: Show Diff displays git show HEAD:<file> against current file content side by side and lets users navigate actual changed hunks.

evidence.title: Scape privacy
evidence.locator: AI Coding Agents; relay; Website Analytics; What We Do Not Collect
evidence.finding: Policy distinguishes no desktop usage telemetry from opt-in marketing-site PostHog analytics, optional relay operational metadata, Keygen activation and model-provider traffic.

evidence.title: Scape terms
evidence.locator: 2 Software License; 3 Purchase Options; 6 Intellectual Property; 7 Prohibited Uses
evidence.finding: The application has a restricted macOS software license; paid use, no free tier and specific older plan/price wording are stated. Redistribution/reverse engineering is prohibited.

evidence.title: Scape changelog
evidence.finding: The current release feed lists v1.145 dated21November2026, v1.144 dated16November and v1.143 dated2November. v1.144 mentions future headless work without establishing a shipped capability.

evidence.title: Scape releases
evidence.locator: Release rows ordered by published_at; tag_name, body and assets
evidence.finding: The app download repository release feed reports v1.145 at 2026-11-21T19:47:02Z, prerelease=false.

evidence.title: Scape release-repository
evidence.finding: The fliptables/scape-releases repository metadata row has archived=false. This is the distribution repository, not the unavailable application source.

evidence.title: Scape issues
evidence.locator: Returned issue/PR titles, state and bodies
evidence.finding: Read the returned public issue/PR rows on the release repository; the application source repository was not established as public.
